observed.meaning: Effective execution and allowed-ACL predicates refused. Exact grantees, grantors, grant options and application sequence were not observed; PUBLIC is not an observed entry.

source_trace: Predecessor20261020220000 lines25-26 explicitly supplies SET true/INHERIT false membership to postgres. SET permits ownership transfer but does not automatically confer object owner privileges.

Functions are created before lines263-269 transfer ownership to calendar_feed_owner. ACL revoke/grants then execute at lines270-272 with no SET ROLE anywhere in the predecessor. now_internal has the same order at196-197.
Current111 executor and owner guards require actual postgres non-superuser and effective owner USAGE false. ADMIN membership is authority over role membership, not a function EXECUTE grant option.
PostgreSQL17 aclnewowner substitutes owner identities in grantor/grantee entries; a NULL ACL instead derives defaults under the new owner. Former creator status is not retained owner authority.

PG17 select_best_grantor searches inherited privilege paths, not merely SET-capable memberships. With ordinary PUBLIC EXECUTE and no independent grant option, postgres has some execution privilege but zero grant options. restrict_and_check_grant warns and applies zero requested privilege bits.

The local all-true fixture used the original superuser for ownership/ACL operations. PG17 treats superuser ACL operations as owner operations; that fixture therefore did not exercise the predecessor's ordinary non-inheriting grantor sequence.

premises: Ordinary non-superuser postgres creates the function with standard PUBLIC EXECUTE and owner rights.
Owner becomes calendar_feed_owner; postgres has SET capability but no inherited owner privileges or independent function grant option.
No unrelated platform trigger, later grant or superuser context modifies the sequence.
deduction: Post-transfer REVOKE ALL by postgres cannot remove the owner's PUBLIC grant; it warns/no-ops rather than necessarily failing the migration.
Subsequent GRANT to authenticated likewise has no grant option. authenticated still executes via PUBLIC, which is distinct from an authenticated-only direct ACL.

anon and service_role also execute through PUBLIC; PUBLIC is outside the allowed owner/authenticated grantee set. Exactly the observed three false bits result, while metadata/body/count remain unchanged.

primary_sources.support: SET and automatic inherited privileges are separate.
Non-owner revocation is limited to grant options; zero grant options can warn without revocation; superuser acts as owner.
aclnewowner; select_best_grantor uses ROLERECURSE_PRIVS; SET capability is distinct.
restrict_and_check_grant restricts requested bits to available grant options; some privilege avoids hard failure.
